about: The stops an unattended run must keep: the 18 of docs/plans/one-go/evidence/v-auto-advance.md section 2 and the calls only the person may cause (the mod's rule personOnly). check names the case or scenario that walks the stop; WP07 fills it. A stop leaves this list only with a decision record.

stops.trigger: Design changed the plan's tasks: the changed tasks need the approval
open areas of concern: a true decision
the stage's gate failed
a manual task: only the person can confirm it
commits the CLI did not make on a group's branch: keeping them is the person's
merging the groups again after such commits were settled
a parked group (a task out of attempts, a blocked task, an agent's commits)
a failed group check whose recommended option needs typing or is Save for later
a failed group check whose recommended option is a step back to Plan
a task that failed on the environment (asked, the run stays armed)
tasks.md has tasks and no groups
a DRIFT row in a fix pass panel: never answered for the person
a failed row with no open finding at medium or above, or a spent repeat budget
a setup fault, a missing measurement, the locked acceptance tests, or a spent repeat budget
a criterion only the person can confirm
the commit question, always
the commit gate failed
the plan question again after any step back to Plan
temper override: a skip of a failed check
temper plan review or plan patch: the Context check answer, a change to the approved plan
temper task confirm or task accept: a manual task confirmed, a covered task accepted
temper adhoc open: a small change
temper acceptance reopen: the locked acceptance tests reopened
temper state set branch: the run's branch
temper group reopen with --accept-foreign: keeping a task agent's commits
temper evidence accept or evidence clear: accepting a finding, clearing a ledger
temper state advance intent_complete or plan_complete: leaving Intent or Plan
temper state loop, state init, state clear, state archive: a step back, starting over, ending the run
temper state set run_mode to anything but interactive: arming an unattended run
temper state set next_stage to an earlier stage: a step back
